'''Bin Factory Housing''' was a residential area for [[Factory/Legends|factory]] workers. It was located within [[Bin Prime]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="EGTPM" />
